_how: Sirf asli client reviews daalo, aur client se poochh lo ki website par naam ke saath dikha sakte hain.
Client haan bole to us review me "approved": true likho. Bina approved ke review website par nahi aata.

Fields: name, role, company, text (client ke apne words), stars (1-5), photo (optional: file public/assets/reviews/ me rakho aur yahan likho assets/reviews/rahul.jpg), project (optional, live website ka link).
Phir site dobara build karo: npm run build
